description: Fields that settle back while the form sends, a submit button whose label rises through sending to a drawn check, and server errors that open in place under the field they belong to.
moves: An error, from the browser or from your server, opens its own height under its field and rises in out of a blur.
The submit button's label rises out to the pending label with a spinner, then to the success label; refused, it comes back down.
The check in the success label strokes itself in.
While the form sends, its fields settle back a little and come forward again when it is done.
The submit button sinks and springs back.
keyboard: In a text field, submits the form. Fields are checked first and the first invalid one takes focus.
Moves between the fields and the submit button.

propDocs.Form.submit: Runs when the form is submitted and every field is valid, with the form's data. Return `{ errors: { name: message } }` to show your messages on those fields, and `{ message }` for one line about the whole form. Throwing refuses the submission with the error's message. Leave it out to submit the browser's way.
propDocs.Form.onStatusChange: Called as the submission moves between `idle`, `submitting`, `success` and `error`, with the reason.
propDocs.Form.resetOnSuccess: Clears the fields once a submission succeeds. The success stays until the next edit.
propDocs.FormSubmit.pendingLabel: What the button says while the form submits.
propDocs.FormSubmit.successLabel: What the button says once the submission succeeds.
